mod.name: item.seed.desc
Reduction Fern: A pinch of downy spores. They take root in a water-poor hydroponic tray, and the mature fronds grow a pale teal layer of reducing agent in their veins.

Reduction Fern: Gene-edited: current drives it to turn minerals and water into reducing agent.

mod.name: item.fronds.desc
Reduction Fern: A handful of fronds tinged pale teal. Crushed, they seep reducing agent - a legal source for Nomore synthesis.

mod.name: item.fronds.flavor
Reduction Fern: Gene-edited: current drives it to turn minerals and water into reducing agent.

mod.name: upgrade.desc
